[LGRA.10.3.7] **A cache key is a literal.** The `key:` of a `cache` or a
`cache_delete` must be a `STRING_LIT` with no interpolation site
([LGRA.2.9.6]), and the compiler must refuse any other value with
`DS_VALIDATE_DYNAMIC_IDENT_KWARG`, at the action, naming the kwarg and the
verb. A key read back by `cached("<key>")` is written the same way
([LSTO.4.3.1]). `value:` and `ttl:` keep [LGRA.10.6]'s freedom.
